title: Alembic Pharma Receives Two USFDA EIRs, Formally Closes Vadodara Facility Inspection

contentHtml:
Vadodara: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited has received two Establishment Inspection Reports (EIRs) from the United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA), confirming the closure of an unannounced inspection conducted at its Bioequivalence Facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, between August 31 and September 10, 2026.

The inspection reports were issued in the names of the respective clinical investigators, marking the formal closure of the inspection process.

The development follows the company's earlier communication dated September 11, 2026, regarding the completion of the unannounced USFDA on-site inspection at the Bioequivalence Facility. The latest update confirms the receipt of two separate EIRs from the US regulatory authority in connection with the inspection.

The two Establishment Inspection Reports were issued in the names of the respective clinical investigators associated with the facility. With the receipt of these reports, the USFDA inspection stands concluded.

Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited is a research-driven, vertically integrated pharmaceutical company headquartered in Vadodara, Gujarat. Established in 1907, the company has more than a century of experience in the pharmaceutical industry and is engaged in the research, development, manufacturing and marketing of pharmaceutical products.

The company's business operations primarily comprise three major segments: India Formulations, International Generics and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs). Its portfolio includes generic pharmaceutical formulations and active pharmaceutical ingredients catering to domestic and international markets.

The company operates research and manufacturing facilities supporting its pharmaceutical development and commercialisation activities. Its Bioequivalence Facility in Vadodara supports its research and development operations, including bioequivalence-related activities associated with pharmaceutical products.
